_description: Trains and evaluates 6 deep functional-map methods on the remeshed SMAL_r animal dataset: SURFMNet, GeomFMaps (supervised baseline), ULRSSM, DUO-FM, HybridFMaps and AttentiveFMaps. Each method = model JSON + trainer JSON. NOTE: this is a heavy compute job (DiffusionNet + per-shape elastic/connection eigendecompositions for Hybrid/DUO-FM + geodesic matrices). Run e.g.:  python -m benchfum.challenges.deep_fmap.run --config benchfum/configs/benchmarks/learning/smal_r_unsup.json --train --device cuda . train_root/val_root point at SMAL_r; the dataset split applies to all splits, so adjust split or point train_root/val_root at split-specific dirs for a strict train/test separation.
